_readme: Rob board manifest. One surface = one page of the models app to rob UI for. level1 = 21st corpus query (lanes + regex over name/desc/tags, ranked by usage, local previews). level2 = shadcn official (view iframes for blocks, docs links for components). level3 = GitHub repos (seeded from the scouts; demo iframes when the site allows). Picks land in rob/votes.json as { '<surface>': { '<url>': { pick: 'yes'|'no', note, at } } }.

surfaces.title: Ask Oracle (chat agent)
surfaces.ask: Ask Oracle must (from the tests on the lane): be silent by default; expand for a cue, thinking, or thread activity and collapse idle silence to the breathing glyph; erupt into the TIP state on a fresh tip and draft a say-this card (never for a stale or pre-session tip); admit one visible nudge, 45s global cooldown, six per ten minutes, stall nudge once per 12 min framed only as a forward idea; queue drafts behind a danger status; keep ONE voice (rest | thinking | tip); show ≤3 follow-up suggestions UNDER each answer that become the next turn, none while thinking, none without data (no chat suggestion without chat, no thank-you without a named fan); load a cue into the real composer; disable input/chips when autonomy is off; single-line prompts only; persist the thread per model per day, prune 48h, isolate threads per session id; answer locally from real figures when the IPC is missing and say so; never dead-end. Shaan: 'we should just have a chat agent that we can talk to and we add all of this stuff on top of the base' + orb (ahmedmayara ai-thinking-orb) and voice state (ia-siri-chat) from the corpus.
